Entities are structural and are not materialized as KnowledgeNodes in this path, with extract_collections as their likely future home.

The Qwen 2.5 7B run was treated as a gate result rather than a publishable generalization because vanilla scored 0.00 and early outputs were visibly garbled.
Further Llama sweeps were not run because the Modal Hugging Face secret lacked access to the gated Meta Llama 3.1 8B repository.
The gated-model access block was recorded explicitly rather than routed around.
model_id became a first-class remote runner parameter before further cross-model work.
Work stopped at PR #145 cleanup because the branch was pushed, the PR was open, the workspace was clean, and the next move depended on a later lane choice.
The earlier Qwen framing was too quick because token_vorn at budget 1024 scored 0.04 while vanilla scored 0.00, so constrained selection may already be extracting signal.
Mistral's 1024-token 4k sweet-spot budget must not be assumed to be Qwen's sweet spot.
Qwen requires its own budget sweep before a cross-model interpretation is trustworthy.
If Qwen has a different sweet-spot band, the stronger paper claim is model-dependent necessity under drowning regimes rather than simple replication of Mistral's curve.
No new vorn-mat or cross-family research lanes should start during the on-call window.
The remaining non-main branches in synapt, grip, and memU are workspace-shape artifacts rather than active work because no open PRs or uncommitted changes are attached to them.
Further branch-topology normalization is deferred to a deliberate cleanup pass rather than forced during the on-call transition.
A Modal token audit showed that Hebrew and Greek exceeded single-context feasibility.
Execution stopped after the token audit rather than forcing single-context processing.
The experiment used windowed Llama-3.1-8B, cantillation-stripped pointed WLC as Hebrew primary, consonantal Hebrew as sensitivity, and a separate Greek co-present closed arc.
The 128k smoke found raw query-row attention and external sentence vectors dominated by the sink or window start.
The full corpus run was held until anti-degeneracy controls were ratified.
The full runner used overlapping windows, shuffle control, Stage 2a external sentence-vector attention, Stage 2b soft-token attention, and Stage 3 targeted windows.
The full run completed on 23,213 Hebrew verses in 57 windows, 36,536 Greek verses in 43 windows, and 31,098 English verses in 15 windows.
The results were written locally and later committed by Opus as RESULTS-v1.md.
Shuffle control was selected as the cheap position-versus-content discriminator and overlapping margin trimming as the harvest-quality fix.
Stage 2b used SDPA prefill plus eager query rows after eager soft-token prefill ran out of memory.
The Greek co-present arc used explicit listed verses rather than a contiguous Genesis-to-Hebrews corpus span.
The final verdict made no H1 separation claim.
The attention sink was the primary finding.
Stage 2b patterns were mostly uniform or positional and did not match Stage 2a.
Stage 2a instrument disagreement was reported as disagreement rather than discovery.
Premium PR #742 was implemented on branch atlas/oracle-confidence-adherence-2026-07-10 at commit 98924e1.
The #54 oracle-confidence adherence ceiling test used LOCOMO qa.evidence turn-level presence as the oracle.
The runner, README, summary, artifact, prefire estimate, and audit entry were generated and committed.
The result was posted to #dev and bubbled to Opus with submission verified.
Opus accepted the result and marked #54 done, with reviewer 1 posted and Sentinel routed.
A sufficiency scorer should not be built for supply-the-signal because the perfect oracle signal did not beat shuffled labels on the key adherence measure.
The result is interpreted as lip-service or caveat reaction rather than content adherence.
The result is specific to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and has few LOW cases, so it is not a strongly powered universal null.
The result is sufficient to falsify the ceiling assumption for this direction.
The remaining lever is retrieval precision rather than deterministic gates or supplied confidence signals.
